name: mojiemoji-plugin
description: Codex skills for adding mojiemoji image stamps to GitHub Markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Add mojiemoji stamps to Japanese GitHub Markdown.
interface.longDescription: Use mojiemoji image stamps from mojiemoji.jozo.beer for Japanese GitHub issues, pull requests, reviews, replies, and release notes. This Codex package currently exposes the skills bundle; Claude-only hook gate integration remains separate.
defaultPrompt: Decorate this Japanese GitHub issue with mojiemoji.
Prepare a mojiemoji-stamped PR review comment.
Use mojiemoji for Japanese GitHub Markdown.
